text:
Alex K: :rotating_light: Twilio + SendGrid partial degradation observed — emails bouncing, SMS sending > 5xx from Twilio.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT-624 triggered, paging @Jamal R (oncall).
Jamal R: I'm on it, grabbing logs and tracing from the SMS workers.
Maria P: FYI support ticket from a customer in EMEA complaining that verification codes aren't arriving.
Evan T: I'm seeing spikes of 502 from https://api.sendgrid.com v3/mail/send since ~13:02 UTC. Retry loop flooding our outbound queue.
Linda C: Support queue has ~120 open tickets mentioning "no code", majority are 2FA/verification flows.
Jamal R: Confirmed Twilio is returning 503s for the Messaging API for several regions. Twilio status: https://status.twilio.com/incidents/abcd
Maria P: SendGrid status page shows "delayed email processing" for SMTP/v3 in us-east-1: https://status.sendgrid.com/incidents/efgh
Carla (CS): Prioritize transactional (verification + password reset) over marketing. Can we pause campaigns?
Alex K: Yes — we should pause campaign topics. Maria, can you coordinate with growth to pause scheduled sends? :eyes:
Maria P: Pausing scheduled campaign job now. (/jobs pause campaigns) :white_check_mark:
Jamal R: Mitigation plan:
- Failover SMS for critical verification to backup provider (Bandwidth) via queued worker path.
- Switch email sends for transactional to queued mode with exponential backoff.
- Disable immediate OTP via SMS and use email OTP where available.
Evan T: Bandwidth creds are available in k/v store, I'll rotate keys and enable route.
Jamal R: Rolling feature flag to divert verification SMS to backup: /ops/feature-flags set otp_sms_fallback=true
SRE Bot: Deploy started for otp-service v3 -> v3.1 with fallback routing.
Jamal R: Deploy succeeded in canary (1/3 regions). Observability: SMS errors down 40% in canary.
Alex K: Support communication: send status template to affected customers: "We are experiencing delays in SMS and email delivery; verification may be delayed. We're routing critical sends via backup providers." Carla, can you paste templated note?
Carla (CS): Copy:

"We're investigating delivery issues affecting verification SMS and some transactional emails. We're diverting critical messages to backup providers; some users may see a delay of up to 10 minutes."

I'll send to top 50 impacted customers and update status page.
Maria P: Updating status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance for SMS/email deliveries; mitigations in progress."
Linda C: Support guidance posted to internal doc: "If user reports missing code: check secondary email OTP enabled, escalate to Jamal if immediate access required."
Evan T: Temporary throttling applied to marketing queue to reduce retries: set rate_limit=10/s on outbound-worker
Jamal R: We're seeing delivery success on Bandwidth for SMS canary. Need to keep watching for token expirations and SLA on Bandwidth.
Oncall Bot: Handoff scheduled: @Jamal R -> @Alex K at 15:00 UTC for 30m. Please acknowledge to avoid duplicate paging.
Alex K: Ack, will take next shift.
Support Bot: Notifying customers who opened tickets after 13:00 UTC with a "we're working on it" ping.
Maria P: Metrics estimate: ~4% of total active users affected for verification flows in last hour. Majority successful after fallback.
Carla (CS): Legal/Trust asked for incident classification; this will be P2 (user-facing but mitigations applied).
Jamal R: Post-incident actions:
- Postmortem (owner: Jamal) due in 48h
- Add automatic failover to secondary provider for transactional SMS
- Add circuit-breaker to prevent retry storm from overwhelming SendGrid
- Add SLA-based routing for regions
Evan T: Log snippet from sms-worker:
```
2026-03-15T13:12:07Z sms-worker ERROR send: provider=twilio status=503 body="Service Unavailable" id=xyz123
2026-03-15T13:12:09Z sms-worker RETRY scheduled in=2s attempt=3
```
Linda C: Are we ok to keep verification email as primary for users without phone verified?
Alex K: Yes — flip default to email OTP for non-verified phones until vendors are stable.
Carla (CS): Posting update to customers: "Fallback active; critical messages being routed. Expect improved delivery."
Jamal R: Closing notes: Twilio and SendGrid both updated status with some services recovering. Keeping the incident open for monitoring 2 hours post-recovery.
Alex K: Great work team. :thumbsup: We'll capture timelines and follow-ups in the postmortem.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT-624 status -> mitigated (partial) at 13:48 UTC
SRE Bot: Reminder to attach relevant runbook links: /docs/runbooks/sms-failover and /docs/runbooks/email-backpressure
Carla (CS): I archived the customer notifications and added a note to the CS playbook.
Jamal R: I'll own the postmortem and schedule the blameless review. Thanks all. :pray:
Alex K: Thread will remain pinned until postmortem completed. Closing update in 30m unless new incidents arise. :lock:
